settings.heading: Privacy Policy
settings.body:
Trefelle collects information needed to process orders, provide customer support, improve the shopping experience, and operate secure checkout. This may include contact details, shipping details, order information, optional account information, device information, cookies, analytics data, and support communications.

We use information to fulfill orders, save carts, provide checkout, maintain optional customer accounts, prevent fraud, send transactional messages, improve products and navigation, and comply with legal, tax, accounting, payment, shipping, and platform obligations.

Our store is hosted by Shopify. We may also use payment processors, shipping carriers, fulfillment partners, suppliers, analytics tools, advertising platforms, and customer support tools as needed to operate the store.

We use essential cookies for cart, checkout, account login, fraud prevention, and store functionality. If analytics or marketing tools are enabled, they may use cookies or similar technologies.

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or opt out of certain uses of personal information. Contact us through Shopify Inbox for privacy requests.
